batch_node.name: StackArmor VDR Archetypes v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Seeds the sixteen archetype nodes of the stackArmor memo's Appendix A (source stackarmor-memo-appendix-a). A starting point the provider owns: the batch imports once, and an archetype edited afterwards is not overwritten. See specs/spec-stackarmor-vdr-v0.md (req-stackarmor-vdr-archetypes).
